JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id

title: Top 10 products - partitioned table + FK index on order_items

FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders_part o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
